title: Triage a red CI, gate or review run into a worker brief
body: Add `krn triage`: when CI, gate:local or review red-first fails, one command collects the failing run log, exact head and base, tool versions and failing test names into a run-folder brief, and prints a one-line verdict plus the brief path for a fresh worker to diagnose. Requested by the previous lead session c00b8515 as an operator-approved scope addition (relayed, not verified by this lead). Cases it must handle: real npm missing in the review sandbox, a test/rules hit such as no-paperclip, wall-clock timeouts under host load, a CI runner lost to CPU starvation. Acceptance: verbatim captures of each case produce a brief and verdict; builds on `krn deliver` (t-pst5y0h) stage failures.
